name: Henry VIII
hook: Six wives, two beheadings, and a break with Rome: the Tudor king Jeopardy loves to ask about.

facts.label: the six wives
facts.statement: Henry VIII married six times; "divorced, beheaded, died, divorced, beheaded, survived" runs from Catherine of Aragon through Catherine Parr.

facts.label: Anne Boleyn
facts.statement: Anne Boleyn was the second wife; Henry had her beheaded on May 19, 1536, then married Jane Seymour 11 days later.

facts.label: Catherine of Aragon
facts.statement: Catherine of Aragon was the first wife, the widow of Henry's brother Arthur and aunt of Emperor Charles V; Henry divorced her.

facts.label: Jane Seymour
facts.statement: Jane Seymour, the third wife, gave Henry his only legitimate son, Edward VI; Henry is buried beside her.

facts.label: Anne of Cleves
facts.statement: Anne of Cleves, the fourth wife, was called "a Flanders mare"; the marriage was annulled after six months in 1540.

facts.label: Catherine Howard
facts.statement: Catherine Howard, the fifth wife, was accused of adultery and beheaded in 1542, like her cousin Anne Boleyn.

facts.label: Catherine Parr
facts.statement: Catherine Parr was the sixth wife and outlived Henry, marrying him in 1543 near the end of his reign.
